_comment: See scripts/report_pipeline.py docstring. Every model runs every rollout; outputs land in <out_root>/<tag>_<run_id>/. frames_per_image is the GLOBAL columns-per-filmstrip constant; n_predict = stride * (frames_per_image - 1).

rollouts.description: a shear-thinning flow past three colliders
an impulsively started flow at $30^\circ$ incidence
the same trajectory sampled every 6th step

_description_note: Optional per-rollout 'description' replaces the run id as the caption subject ("Model comparison on <description>"). Inserted verbatim so LaTeX works; escape literal _ & % # yourself.
_include_context_note: GLOBAL: prepend the model's context (input) frames to every filmstrip, above the Real row and cut off by a heavy rule. Ordered newest-first; extra slots stay blank, surplus context frames are dropped oldest-first.
_postfix_note: Optional per-rollout 'postfix' is appended to the output folder so one run can appear multiple times (e.g. different strides). Two rollouts resolving to the same folder is a hard error.
_flags_note: 'include_context' and 'include_refiner_detail' are per-rollout; a top-level value of either acts as the default for every rollout. Defaults: context off, refiner detail on (when a refiner ran).
